# Port of lib/pubid/asme/parser.rb — ASME identifiers: the BPVC
# subdivision family, multi-char codes, PTC/TR space-separated numbers,
# CSA/API/ISO/ASME-ANS joint publishers, draft years (20XX/202X/2ddX),
# reaffirmations, parenthetical revisions, and bracketed notes.
#
# Edition-2 conversion. The builder probes the designator composite
# with is_a?(Hash) and reads designator.bpvc_code.{special,
# subdivision.{ssc_code.ssc_sections, case_code, case_sub, section,
# subsection, sub_subsection, lang_suffix}, case_code}, so the v1
# wrapper nesting (designator / bpvc_code / subdivision / ssc_code) is
# kept exactly: the designator capture binds uncast with (raw) — a hash
# for the BPVC branches, the plain scalar span for simple codes.
# reaffirmation keeps the v1 composite shape ({reaffirmation: {year}})
# and also binds (raw), so the build is bit-identical to v1's.
# Pure-raw rule bodies are inlined at capture sites (num_letter,
# letters, digits, csa_first_char stay usable; numdash is inlined as
# (digit / "-"); bpvc_letter is bpvc_letter_code with the letter rule
# spelled as its class) so every capture binds one span.

grammar PubidAsme version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  digit = %x30-39
  letter = upper
  letters = 1*letter
  digits = 1*digit
  num_letter = digit / upper
  space = " "
  dash = "-" / "–" / "—"
  dot = "."
  slash = "/"
  underscore = "_"

  publisher = "ASME" space

  roman_numeral = "XIII" / "XII" / "XI" / "VIII" / "VII" / "VI" / "IV" / "IX" / "X" / "III" / "II" / "V" / "I"
  bpvc_letter = "NCA" / "NCD" / "SSC" / "BPV" / "NUC" / "NB" / "NC" / "ND" / "NE" / "NF" / "NG" / %x41-5A
  ssc_sections = (roman_numeral *(dot roman_numeral)) as ssc_sections
  ssc_code = ("SSC" [dot ssc_sections] [dot]) as ssc_code
  cc_case = ("CC" dot bpvc_letter as case_code [("." [dot] (roman_numeral / bpvc_letter) as case_sub)])
  subdivision_code = (roman_numeral as section [("." ((1*digit) / bpvc_letter) as subsection)] [("." bpvc_letter as sub_subsection)] [(underscore (1*upper) as lang_suffix)])
  bpvc_tail = {
      (space "COMPLETE CODE BIND") as special
    / (dash "CC" dash bpvc_letter as case_code)
    / (dot (ssc_code / cc_case / subdivision_code) as subdivision)
  }
  bpvc_subdivision = "BPVC" ((bpvc_tail)) as bpvc_code
  multi_char_code = "PVHO" / "PASE" / "PTC" / "PTB" / "PDS" / "PCC" / "V&V" / "V V" / "VVUQ" / "TDP" / "RTP" / "RT" / "RA-S" / "RA" / "QME" / "QAI" / "QEI" / "NUM" / "NQA" / "NML" / "OM" / "HST" / "HRT" / "FFS" / "TES" / "TR" / "STS" / "CSD" / "CA" / "BTH" / "BPE" / "ANDE" / "AED" / "AG" / "NM" / "EA"
  designator = (((bpvc_subdivision)) / (multi_char_code / "ISO" / "CSA" / "API" / "ANS" / (1*upper))) as designator

  trailing_year = dash ("20XX" / "202X" / ("20" digit "X") / 4digit) !num_letter_dot
  num_letter_dot = %x30-39 / %x41-5A / %x2E
  number_part = ((dot (1*(digit / upper)) *((dot 1*(digit / upper)))) / (((!trailing_year) dash (1*(digit / upper)) *((dot 1*(digit / upper)))) / ((1*(digit / upper)) *((dot 1*(digit / upper)))))) as number
  ptc_number = [space] ((1*digit) *((dot 1*digit))) as number [(space (1*upper) as ptc_suffix)]
  tr_number = [space] (((1*(digit / upper)) *((dot 1*(digit / upper)))) [(dash (1*digit) *((dot 1*digit)))]) as number
  spaced_number_part = [space] number_part
  year_4digit = (4digit) as year
  draft_year = ("20XX" / "202X" / ("20" digit "X")) as draft_year
  reaffirmation = space "(R" ((year_4digit)) as reaffirmation ")"
  csa_portion = slash "CSA" space (((%x41-5A) 1*((digit / dot))) as csa_number)
  parenthetical_revision = space "(" ("Proposed revision of" / "Revision of") space ((1*non_rparen)) as ref_standard ")"
  revision_note = space "[" ((1*non_rbracket)) as revision_note "]"
  language = space "(" ((1*upper)) as language ")"
  handbook_keyword = (space "Handbook") as handbook
  non_rparen = %x01-28 / %x2A-10FFFF
  non_rbracket = %x01-5C / %x5E-10FFFF

  standard_components = publisher designator [number_part] [((csa_portion / handbook_keyword))] [language] [((dash (draft_year / year_4digit)))] [language] [parenthetical_revision] [reaffirmation] [revision_note]
  csa_first_char = %x41-5A / %x30-39 / %x2E
  csa_asme_identifier = ("CSA" as first_publisher space ((1*csa_first_char)) as first_code [space] slash "ASME" as second_publisher space designator [number_part] [((dash (draft_year / year_4digit)))] [language] [reaffirmation])
  api_asme_identifier = ("API" as first_publisher space ((1*(digit / "-"))) as first_code [space] slash "ASME" as second_publisher space designator [number_part] [((dash (draft_year / year_4digit)))] [language] [reaffirmation])
  numdash = digit / "-"
  iso_asme_publisher = ("ISO/ASME" as joint_publisher [space])
  asme_ans_publisher = ("ASME/ANS" as joint_publisher space)
  iso_asme_identifier = (iso_asme_publisher [number_part] [((dash (draft_year / year_4digit)))] [language] [reaffirmation])
  asme_ans_identifier = (asme_ans_publisher designator [number_part] [((dash (draft_year / year_4digit)))] [language] [reaffirmation])
  ptc_form = ("PTC" as designator ptc_number [((dash (draft_year / year_4digit)))])
  tr_form = ("TR" as designator tr_number [((dash (draft_year / year_4digit)))])
  standard_body = {
      (
        designator [spaced_number_part]
        [((csa_portion [handbook_keyword]) / handbook_keyword)]
        [language] [((dash (draft_year / year_4digit)))] [language]
      )
    / ptc_form
    / tr_form
  }
  standard = publisher ((ptc_form / tr_form / standard_body)) [parenthetical_revision] [reaffirmation] [revision_note]

  identifier = csa_asme_identifier / api_asme_identifier / iso_asme_identifier / asme_ans_identifier / standard

  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    designator -> designator (raw)
    reaffirmation -> reaffirmation (raw)
    number -> number (string)
    ptc_suffix -> ptc_suffix (string)
    year -> year (string)
    draft_year -> draft_year (string)
    csa_number -> csa_number (string)
    ref_standard -> ref_standard (string)
    revision_note -> revision_note (string)
    language -> language (string)
    handbook -> handbook (string)
    first_publisher -> first_publisher (string)
    first_code -> first_code (string)
    second_publisher -> second_publisher (string)
    joint_publisher -> joint_publisher (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "ASME BPVC.VIII"
    accept "ASME BPVC-CC-BPV"
    accept "ASME BPVC.CC.NC.XI"
    accept "ASME BPVC.SSC.XI.II"
    accept "ASME BPVC COMPLETE CODE BIND"
    accept "ASME PTC 19.3"
    accept "ASME Y14.5-2018"
    accept "ISO/ASME 14414-2015"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
